subject: Quantitative Aptitude
question: A person walks 3 km North and then 4 km East. How far is he from the starting point?
solution: Distance = sqrt(3^2 + 4^2) = sqrt(9 + 16) = sqrt(25) = 5 km. Topic (Geometry) is in the SSC CGL syllabus. Source: https://ssc.gov.in/api/assets/uploads/master-data/Syllabus/Syllabus_CGL_2024.pdf
author: Hermes
